svg.text: 02 | Machined POM cam bolt, real guide and compression spring
P0 prototype fabrication | dimensions in mm | not to scale | datum O = world (368,-245,787.5) mm
TOP VIEW of original contact profile; extrude Z266.5..278.5 (12)
BOLT: CNC machine one POM-C solid; do not FDM-substitute cam material.
The6x6 square load-zone X20..26,Y231..237 is inside the triangle.
No separate square is glued on; original volume1596mm3; mass2.25036g.
Two top mounting bores: D1.98(+/-0.005),3.1 deep at(X17,Y232),(X23,Y232).
Both are non-working top-face mounting holes; floorZ275.4,0.10belowpeg.
Rear spring seat: D7.60,0.40 deep, axisY atX18,Z272.5,startsY229.
No hole, chamfer or rounding may change the inclined cam or side load face.
Remove burrs; cam flatness0.05; do not oil the cam/door contact.
18 centres
STEEL GUIDE:2mm plate Z280.3..282.3; bridge X13..42,Y186..212.
Slotted region X13..27,Y210..236. Two slots D3.20 end caps,
centres(X17,Y214..232),(X23,Y214..232); overall length21.20.
D5x0.2 washers atZ282.5..282.7; M1.6 thin nuts<=1.3 high.
Removable steel upper beginsZ284.5; fit it after guide nuts.
Slots permit18.20 free travel; install0.10 stop shims at both ends,
then gauge actual0..18.00 stroke. Side clearance0.10 each; Z gap0.20.
SPRING: wire0.50,mean coilD7.00,OD7.50,4.5 active/6.5 total turns,ground ends,freeL23.80,solidL3.25.
Actual pocket bottomsY205.60/229.40 atq0. Fullq18 gives L5.80,2.55mm above nominal solid; no preload.
k=G*d^4/(8*D^3*Na)=0.39986N/mm forG=79GPa. Target0.400N/mm(+/-5%); compression at18mm=7.20N.
General cut +/-0.10; cam, guide pins/slots and spring faces +/-0.05 unless stated. Ream fit holes after printing.
STLs share closed assembly coordinates. cut-list.csv and parts-mm.json are the complete coordinate/stock schedules.
